dimensions.source: The set page's Products included rows and Dimensions tab, read in Chrome 2026-11-10, with the Black finish selected. The footprint is the table's. Bob's W is the long side (w), D is across (d).

notes: Andrew, 2026-11-10, after the first ranking: "I want it at least 72" long. I don' want the ends to block guests' feet ,I hate that" (F-60). RANKED 1 of 3 on Bob's under that rule: black, 72" long on four square legs at its corners, with six chairs, at the Black Friday page's price. Flags: tight:28 (F-36). Fit (dining-room, 98 x 89 between the two walkways, F-42): along the room's depth, 42" across leaves 28" a side, 2" under F-36's workable 30" (F-36's cap is 38"); set 2" toward the kitchen, the wall side gets its 30" and the kitchen side 26" to the walkway's edge, its chairs backing into the walkway as F-36 allows that side. 72" long, its living-room end on that walkway's edge, it leaves 17" to the bottom wall: three chairs a side between the corner legs (3 x 20" chairs), no end seat. The set ("Set includes: table and 6 chairs"): the Brookline Black Dining Table (SKU 10001343008) and six Brookline Black & White Upholstered Dining Chairs (SKU 10001343002, 24" deep), "Bob's Bundled Price" $799.00; Bob-O-Pedic memory foam seats. The same set in Brown & White (other-bobs-20100412) is on the Black Friday Dining Rooms $799 and Under page at $799.00. The brown table alone is $399.00 (other-bobs-10001220007); the black table's own page was not opened. Color (F-68 (10)): Finish Group Black, a charcoal-black table and black chair frames in the photos, the strongest contrast on the white marble; the seats and backs are white polyester fabric (Color Group White), which a 4-year-old will stain: Bob's sells its Goof Proof plan for the set at $99.99. Transitional; MDF, solid acacia, rubberwood solids, oak veneers. 719 reviews. Get it as soon as Nov 13 (to 11101); free pickup at the Piscataway, NJ distribution center; see it in person at the Long Island City store. Returns (Bob's Returns tab, 2026-11-10): an order cancels for a full refund until delivery or pickup day; after delivery Bob's takes furniture back only for factory defects. See it in person before ordering. No photo: Bob's images are on res.cloudinary.com/mybobs/, which catalog:image refuses until Andrew allows that folder.
